description: Index Syntax-Directed Operations by the grammar production they handle. SDOs are abstract operations (Evaluation, BoundNames, etc.) with one `<emu-alg>` per production. Default by='production' returns { [production]: [{ sdo, id, title }] }; by='sdo' returns { [sdo title]: [productions] }. `filter` substring-narrows keys; `spec` selects '262' or '402'.

by.description: Index direction. 'production' (default) groups SDO definitions by the production they handle. 'sdo' groups productions by which SDO defines them.

edition.description: Edition within the chosen spec. ECMA-262: es2016 … es2026, main. ECMA-402: es2016 … es2026, main. Aliases: latest, draft, next.

limit.description: Cap the number of groups returned. Each group can still hold many entries.

spec.description: Which TC39 spec to read: '262' (core language, default) or '402' (Internationalization API).

name: spec.sdo_index
title: Syntax-directed operations index
